items.docs:
Initiates or continues a cookie-based authentication flow.
Starts with username/password. If successful and MFA is not required, returns user data and sets a session cookie.
If MFA is required, or a new password needs to be set, the response will indicate the next step and provide a sessionToken.
This is primarily for UI interaction, LLMs should typically use API Key Authentication.

Sends an email with a password reset link to the user associated with the provided email address, if an account exists.
This is part of the cookie-based authentication flow.

info.name: Confirm new password after reset request

items.docs:
Completes the password reset process. The user provides the new password and the confirmation code received via email.
This is part of the cookie-based authentication flow.

Invalidates the current authenticated user session (cookie-based).
Can also be used to log out other or all sessions for the user.
Verifies if the current cookie-based session is still valid and authenticated.
